name: 3D Strategic Defense & Missile Command
description: Ultra-realistic 3D Strategic Defense & Global Warfare simulator inspired by superpower conflicts. Features 360-degree mobile touch orbit controls, Diplomatic Crisis & Peace Broker Engine (DEFCON 1-5), 80+ skyscraper metropolis, Phased-Array radar, Laser Point-Defense CIWS, 80+ physics debris structural crumble, persistent impact craters, and satellite war-room intelligence.
